data.name: installer-error.dual-boot-requires-winpod
data.value: For dual boot, the iPod must keep Apple's original firmware in "winpod" format: an MBR partition table with Apple's firmware partition intact plus a FAT32 partition — the format iTunes creates when restoring on a Windows PC. This iPod is in Mac format (Apple/HFS partitions, which Rockbox cannot read) or its disk is unreadable, and preparing it from here would erase the whole disk, including the original firmware. Options: restore the iPod with iTunes/Apple Devices and try dual boot again, or install only the firmware if you do not need to keep Apple's.

Then try again: the iPod is already in DFU mode, so the retry should reach this same step quickly.

The three video categories Aura ships with are shown in the app's language, but inside they're always stored the same so your library looks the same on any computer.
